baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal construction linking the imperatives to what was advanced in the elapsed days.
baseline_models.mechanism: Eating is an allotted provision, drinking is an allotted water share, and wholesome ease is the form in which a prior advance is redeemed after a temporal interval.

activation_trace.role: The consumable-share image makes eating the redemption form of an allotted provision.
The allotted-water image gives drinking the form of receiving one's assigned share.
Easy wholesome benefit specifies that the redeemed provision carries no harmful remainder.
The advance-money or loan image supplies the deferred-transfer mechanism.
An open span of time supplies the interval across which the advance travels.
Passing away or elapsing marks the prior days as gone while their advance remains effective.

changed_reading.before: A pleasant banquet is granted because of earlier conduct.
changed_reading.after: Earlier conduct has been advanced across elapsed time and is now redeemed as an allotted, bodily, harmless provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adverbial wholesome ease governing eating and drinking, together with the past-day qualifier.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reward is not only possession of food and drink but their unobstructed assimilation: benefit permeates the recipient while the old advance closes without liability or anxious residue.

activation_trace.role: Permeating or being imbued turns drinking into complete inward assimilation.
Easy wholesome benefit makes the assimilation safe rather than merely pleasurable.
The loan image creates an exposure that can later be settled.
Being clear of liability supplies the release produced when the prior advance reaches settlement.

changed_reading.before: Wholesome means that the meal tastes pleasant.
changed_reading.after: Wholesome marks a whole-body and account-level safety: the provision enters without resistance and the prior exposure leaves no liability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The advance verb stands between a meal command and the elapsed days.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of the advance root names food served before the meal, allowing the past life to function as an advance course and the present eating and drinking as completion of one meal stretched across time.

activation_trace.role: Food advanced before a meal supplies the two-course temporal analogy.
Literal food ingestion supplies the later course that completes the sequence.
Literal drinking completes the meal rather than standing outside the temporal analogy.
The open span of time stretches the two courses across distinct phases of existence.

changed_reading.before: Past deeds externally purchase a later meal.
changed_reading.after: Past action is the advance course of a single temporally extended meal whose completion is now eaten and drunk.

context_deltas.mechanism: The advance-provision baseline becomes an embodied audit: the record fixes judgment, the right side marks favorable realization, the account counts, and satisfaction follows. Eating is the material execution of that settlement.

activation_trace.role: The advance-money image remains the focus-side item awaiting settlement.
The consumable-share image makes the settlement materially edible.
A written fixing that obliges judgment supplies the enforceable record.
Blessing attached to the right side marks the handed record as favorable realization.
Counting and accounting provide the operation that resolves the advance.
Satisfaction rather than displeasure supplies the affective result of the favorable account.

structural_cues: The sequence immediately before the focus moves from a handed and publicly read record to anticipated account and satisfied life before issuing the eating command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a binding record, favorable handedness, account, and satisfaction; I infer that the causal phrase closes that audit in edible form. A live alternative is that the meal remains gracious reward rather than an exact wage.

changed_reading.before: The advance is repaid as provision in a broad metaphorical sense.
changed_reading.after: The meal is the bodily execution of a written, counted, and favorably settled account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior action behaves like cultivation whose yield has matured. The garden holds the crop, harvest time arrives, and the fruit is brought near so that eating is uptake of a grown return rather than receipt of an abstract payment.

activation_trace.role: Fruit or yield makes eating the terminal uptake of a productive cycle.
Watered land and green growth connect drinking to the irrigation side of the same cycle.
Precedence supplies the prior input from which the later yield develops.
A garden screened by trees supplies the productive environment around the focus meal.
The arrival of harvest time turns prior growth into presently available food.
Nearness makes the mature return approach the eater instead of remaining remote.

structural_cues: Garden, near harvest, and the eating command form an uninterrupted three-ayah sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tree-covered garden, ripened harvest, nearness, and a focus yield branch; I infer that prior deeds function like cultivation. The live alternative is a reward scene with no claim that deeds themselves grow into fruit.

changed_reading.before: The meal is a provision transferred from an account.
changed_reading.after: The meal is a matured return: what was placed earlier has grown, reached harvest, and moved within reach of the eater.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wholesome ease becomes a safety profile rather than a flavor note. The opposing sequence supplies heat entering the belly, blazing fire, encounter with burning, a hot-water branch, and cleansing matter inverted into food; the focus meal is free of burning, obstruction, and corrupt residue.

activation_trace.role: The image of water that is drinkable yet unpleasant supplies the near alternative that wholesome ease excludes.
Easy wholesome benefit makes harmless reception the defining quality of the focus intake.
Heat penetrating the belly supplies an internal anti-image to harmless assimilation.
Blazing fire and severe heat provide the external source of the corrupted bodily state.
Encountering fire and its heat makes harmful contact the opposite of wholesome intake.
Hot water places a branch-level anti-drink inside the verse's missing-intimate image.
Cleansing by flowing water becomes inverted into food, supplying corrupt residue rather than removal of residue.

structural_cues: After the left-hand account, the sequence moves through binding, fire, bodily insertion, loss of intimacy, and corrupted food, repeatedly placing harm near routes of intake.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies penetrating heat, burning, hot water, cleansing residue turned into food, and the focus wholesome-benefit branch; I infer that wholesome specifies freedom from harmful aftereffects. A live alternative is that the context branches remain separate punishment images and do not define the focus modifier.

changed_reading.before: Wholesome means that the feast is agreeable and pleasant.
changed_reading.after: Wholesome means that intake remains beneficial through the whole bodily passage, without burning, coercion, or corrupt residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The causal history of one's own food is socially recursive. Failure to urge feeding the poor is followed by denied and inverted food, while the focus grants wholesome provision; how food was circulated toward vulnerable others returns as the eater's own food condition.

activation_trace.role: An allotted edible provision is the favorable side of the returning food relation.
Giving and maintenance keeps the focus meal connected to provision offered beyond the self.
Priorness places the social food relation among the acts that can return later.
Urging toward an act makes food provision a mobilized social obligation, not private sentiment.
Feeding another or seeking food identifies the specific social transfer that was withheld.
Destitution supplies the vulnerable recipient whose food relation tests the prior life.
Cleansing by flowing water becomes inverted into food, marking a corrupted provision cycle.
The consumable-share image shows that the punitive eater also receives an allotted provision, but of the opposite quality.
Sin and offense identify the conduct class to which the inverted food is assigned.

structural_cues: The left-hand account moves directly from failed encouragement of feeding to absence of wholesome food and then repeats the focus eating root with a punitive object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failure to urge feeding, poverty, corrupted food, and a contrasting eating assignment; I infer that food circulation is one component of what was advanced and returned. A live alternative is that feeding is one example among many deeds and not the exclusive cause of the focus feast.

changed_reading.before: The feast rewards an individual's stock of prior good deeds.
changed_reading.after: The eater's final provision recursively reflects how food was or was not moved toward vulnerable people in the prior days.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus imperatives preserve bodily subjecthood: recipients act on provision by eating and drinking. The opposing sequence captures, binds, and inserts the person, turning the body into material acted upon. Reward therefore includes agency over intake, not food alone.

activation_trace.role: Literal eating casts the recipient as the agent who acts on matter.
Literal drinking extends that agency to controlled bodily intake.
Capture and imprisonment reverse agency by making the person the seized object.
A collar binding an organ converts the body from consumer into constrained material.
Inserting one thing into another makes the person undergo the same directional relation that food normally undergoes.

structural_cues: Active plural imperatives in the focus contrast with singular object suffixes in the commands to seize, bind, and insert.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite grammatical roles and branches of capture, binding, and insertion; I infer that subjecthood over bodily intake is itself part of the reward. A live alternative is that the grammar simply reports two outcomes without foregrounding agency as a theme.

changed_reading.before: The contrast concerns pleasant food versus punishment.
changed_reading.after: The contrast also concerns bodily directionality: one person freely puts provision into the body, while the other body is seized and put into a constraining medium.

context_deltas.mechanism: The loan image in the focus is prevented from becoming ordinary commerce. On the unfavorable side the account remains, but conventional wealth cannot suffice and authority perishes; only what was actually advanced in prior days can return as final provision.

activation_trace.role: The loan image supplies an economic analogy whose currency the context then restricts.
The consumable share is the non-fungible return produced by the valid advance.
Counting and account remain the decisive settlement system on the unfavorable side.
Sufficiency supplies the capacity that ordinary assets explicitly fail to provide.
Possessing and multiplying wealth identifies the conventional currency that proves useless.
Falling into loss and disappearance removes the person's former means from the settlement.
Power and authority identify a second worldly asset that cannot survive into the account.

structural_cues: The left-hand sequence moves from not knowing the account to the failure of wealth and disappearance of authority before bodily punishment begins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies account, failed sufficiency, wealth, loss, and vanished authority; I infer that the focus advance is non-fungible and cannot be replaced by accumulated assets. A live alternative is that the verses condemn one person's failed assets without defining the currency of the focus metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The loan image can sound like an ordinary credit balance payable from whatever wealth one holds.
changed_reading.after: The only effective advance is prior action itself; money and authority are non-convertible and cannot become the final edible share.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping from the eating root to a totality branch, while the surface verb still ordinarily denotes eating. It remains anchored in the focus imperative and its wholesome modifier; downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant resonance of completeness, not as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The eating imperative read through its supplied non-dominant split-root inventory.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness make the permitted reception sound unrestricted and without remainder.
Easy wholesome benefit contains the completeness as safe reception rather than excess.

changed_reading.before: The recipients are simply permitted to eat.
changed_reading.after: The permission faintly resonates as complete, unreserved reception of the provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context surface denotes the left side, while the retained branch names cold wine or a drink that covers the mind. It remains anchored in the focus drinking and understanding branches; downstream prose should present it only as a branch-distant cognitive anti-drink, never as a gloss of the left hand.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The wholesome drinking imperative read as inward absorption that does not damage understanding.

activation_trace.role: Absorbing as understanding lets drinking describe clear cognitive intake as well as liquid intake.
Easy wholesome benefit keeps that cognitive absorption clear and unharmed.
Cold wine or mind-covering drink supplies a form-distant opposite to wholesome cognitive absorption.

changed_reading.before: The favorable and unfavorable recipients differ only in handedness and outcome.
changed_reading.after: The left-side branch faintly introduces a mind-covering anti-drink, while the focus drink can be carried as clear, wholesome absorption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the smooth drinking branch belongs to the context word for chain, whose local sense is plainly punitive. It remains anchored in the focus drinking and permeation branches and in the context's explicit insertion grammar; downstream prose should render it as a material reversal between two kinds of passage, not as a claim that the chain means drink.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The drinking imperative and its image of liquid permeating the recipient.

activation_trace.role: Permeation makes wholesome liquid the thing that passes smoothly into the person.
Wholesome ease distinguishes beneficial passage from coercive insertion.
Smoothness in flowing and drinking creates the branch-distant anti-image inside the chain scene.
Insertion of one thing into another reverses the direction of wholesome intake by making the person the inserted object.

changed_reading.before: Drinking and chaining are unrelated reward and punishment details.
changed_reading.after: They form an exploratory passage reversal: wholesome liquid enters the free person, whereas the constrained person is forcibly entered into a linked medium.

strongest_changes: The meal became the embodied close of a written, favorably handed, and counted account.
The garden and near harvest changed repayment into a grown return that approaches the eater.
The punishment sequence changed wholesome from pleasant flavor into safety across the whole route of intake.
The failed feeding of the poor and punitive food made one's final provision recursively social.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah joined account, harvest, bodily safety, social circulation, and agency mechanisms without forcing them into one reading; split and branch-distant cues also exposed carefully contained resonances of totality, cognitive drink, and reversed passage.
remaining_uncertainties: The loan branch supports settlement language, but the failure of wealth shows that this is not ordinary fungible commerce.
The social-feeding sequence may identify one decisive component of prior action rather than exhaust the causal phrase.
The split-root and branch-distant outliers should remain qualified resonances rather than surface-level lexical claims.
